irUnavailable: IR Blaster not available on this device.
irTabWarning: IR tab is available, but this phone does not have IR hardware. Open IR tab to see setup guidance.
irUnavailableTitle: IR Mode Unavailable on this Device
irIssueReason: Reason: This phone does not expose a Consumer IR emitter, so direct IR signal transmission cannot start.
irInstructionStep1: Step 1: Use an Android phone with built-in IR blaster support.
irInstructionStep2: Step 2: Select your TV/AC brand, then test power and volume keys first.
irInstructionStep3: Step 3: If IR is unavailable, use Smart Devices tab on same WiFi network.
smartGuideStep1: Step 1: Keep phone and TV/AC on the same WiFi network.
smartGuideStep2: Step 2: Tap Retry to rescan, then tap a device to pair.
smartGuideStep3: Step 3: After pairing, use control buttons and test YouTube/Navigation for TV.
universalGuideStep1: Universal mode gives quick controls for TV and AC from one place.
universalGuideStep2: If IR is supported, commands are sent by IR; otherwise smart-device fallback is used.
universalGuideStep3: Best practice: pair devices in Smart tab first, then use Universal for daily quick actions.
